body.h1: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A CONTROL INTERFACE OF AN EXERCISE
body.p: MACHINE DURING THE ENJOY CONSUMPTION OF [[A]] MULTIMEDIA CONTENT AND RELATED MACHINE
On page 1, please amend the paragraph in the "FIELD OF THE INVENTION" as follows:

The present invention relates to the fitness sector, and in particular to a method for controlling a control interface of an exercise machine during the enjoy of a multimedia content and related cxcrcisc machine during the enjoyment of multimedia content, as well as to a related exercise machine.
